# appsignal_app_notifiers (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up the notifiers of an existing app, optionally filtered by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get all notifiers of an app
data "appsignal_app_notifiers" "all" {
  app_id = "abcdef"
}

# Get the notifiers of an app with a specific name
data "appsignal_app_notifiers" "slack" {
  app_id = "abcdef"
  name   = "Slack"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app. Must be specified.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name to filter the notifiers by. Only notifiers with exactly this name are returned. When omitted, all notifiers of the app are returned.

### Read-Only

- `notifiers` (Attributes List) The notifiers matching the given filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notifiers))

<a id="nestedatt--notifiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifiers`

Read-Only:

- `icon` (String) The icon of the notifier.
- `id` (String) The ID of the notifier.
- `name` (String) The name of the notifier.
